proposed_widenings.name: modify_carrying_capacity
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing species_trait/passive family can encode the Grappled-escape advantage rider, but the carrying-capacity rider changes encumbrance math without changing the creature's actual size. No current effect atom or surface variant models effective larger size for carrying capacity only.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity."

notes: Did not author content/species_goliath_powerful_build.dhall because a partial encoding would omit the carrying-capacity mechanic. The first sentence would fit existing passive mechanics via modify_roll_advantage on ability_check with conditionFilter=["grappled"].
